name: NanoTrasen
text:
**30 FPS HAS BEEN REACHED IN CUTSCENES** and CGBJ reports a stable **25 FPS in gameplay!**

The leading project (CGBJ) was public, however it has since been taken down temporarily. Video footage shows that it runs stable on 10 GB of system memory and 16 GB of VRAM. No reddit, that is not a typo. Graphics look amazing but still room to improve.

See video: https://v.redd.it/137k5pow5w3i1
Shout out to the folks at /tg/station 13 😘
